meta.originalInput: You can hold a small weight for a minute without feeling it. But hold that same weight for an hour, and your arm starts to ache. Hold it for a day, and your muscle gives out. The weight never changed. What changed was the duration. Burnout is rarely caused by a catastrophic collapse. It is the quiet accumulation of pressure you convinced yourself was too small to put down. Set the weight down before the structure breaks.
